A small installer fix.

### What's changed
- **Cleaner updates.** Updating now replaces the program's screen files completely, so files an older version used and a newer one doesn't are removed instead of being left behind in the program folder.

Existing installs keep all their templates, clients and people.

### Updating
An administrator will see **Version 3.0.4 is available** at the top of the program — choose **Update now**. Or download the setup below and run it over the top.

### New install
Download **ID-Card-Printing-Software-Free-Setup-3.0.4.exe** below and run it. The setup isn't code-signed, so the first time Windows may show *Windows protected your PC*: choose **More info**, then **Run anyway**, then **Yes**.
